d: Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke varishth neta mukesh raushan ne bihar ki rajniti aur nitish setu ke udghatan karyakram ko lekar bara siyasi dava kiya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue rajad neta mukesh raushan ne kaha ki pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane se nitish kumar naraj hain aur ve kal pradhanmantri narendr modi ke karyakram men shamil nahin honge, jabki is setu ka udghatan pradhanmantri hi karenge.
